title: Luxe Rooftop Stay w/ Hot Tub & City Skyline Views!
description:
Welcome to Wild Spur! This modern 4-story Music City retreat features 3 bedrooms and 3 full baths (1 King, 4 Queens,) + an attached 2-car garage. Unwind on the 3rd-floor private balcony, or head up to the 4-story rooftop deck to soak in the hot tub, fire up the grill, and take in panoramic skyline views. Minutes from Broadway honky-tonks, Germantown dining, and top attractions. Includes exclusive guest VIP perks for luxury chauffeur services & boat rentals!

The space
Wild Spur is a modern, 4-story Music City townhome designed for group comfort, effortless entertaining, and unforgettable Nashville getaways. Featuring dedicated sleeping areas across 3 bedrooms (including a Queen-over-Queen bunk room, 2 Queen beds, and a private King suite), this home balances open communal gathering spaces with comfortable private retreats.

Enjoy morning coffee from the 3rd-floor private balcony, park effortlessly in the attached 2-car garage, or head up to the 4th-floor rooftop patio to soak in the hot tub and grill out with panoramic skyline views.

The Space & Floor Plan Breakdown

1st Floor:

Bedroom 1: 1 Queen-over-Queen Bunk Bed with a private en-suite full bathroom.

Garage: Attached 2-car garage providing secure parking and storage.

2nd Floor (Main Gathering Hub):

Living & Dining Area: Open-concept layout featuring comfortable seating and a smart TV setup.

Gourmet Kitchen: Fully equipped with stainless steel appliances, cookware, and modern finishes.

Bedroom 2: 2 Queen Beds with direct access to a Jack-and-Jill style full bathroom.

3rd Floor (Primary Suite & Balcony):

Bedroom 3 (Primary Suite): 1 King Bed with a private en-suite full bathroom.

Private Balcony: Outdoor retreat accessible directly from the 3rd floor.

4th Floor (Rooftop Deck):

Private Rooftop Patio: Expansive rooftop outdoor lounge featuring a private hot tub, gas grill, outdoor seating, and skyline views.

Key Highlights & Amenities

Comfortable Group Sleeping: 4 real beds (1 King, 2 Queens, 1 Queen-over-Queen bunk) carefully laid out across 4 levels.

4th-Floor Rooftop Oasis: Private rooftop deck with a hot tub, BBQ gas grill, and skyline views.

Attached 2-Car Garage: Rare off-street parking for up to 2 vehicles.

Yale Smart Lock Integration: Keyless entry with a personalized code provided prior to arrival for simple 24/7 self check-in starting at 4 PM.

Prime Location: Minutes from Broadway's honky-tonks, Germantown dining, Centennial Park, and local spots.

The BetterBNB VIP Guest Experience

As our guest at Wild Spur, you gain exclusive priority access and guest discounts through our local Nashville luxury network:

Luxury Transportation: White-glove chauffeur services including Executive Mercedes Sedans, Cadillac Escalades, Mercedes Sprinter Vans, and Corporate Charter Buses (requires booking at least 2 weeks prior to check-in for airport pickups).

The Southern Marinas Collection: Exclusive guest discounts on premium boat rentals (wakeboarding boats, tritoons, and luxury pontoons) at Four Corners Resort & Marina (Percy Priest Lake) and Cedar Creek Marina (Old Hickory Lake).

Guest access
Each property is equipped with a Yale smart lock—you’ll receive a personalized entry code in your check-in instructions prior to arrival. No keys to keep track of, and easy self check-in any time after 4 PM.

Other things to note
Here is an updated Other Things to Note section specifically tailored for Wild Spur:

Other Things to Note

Age & Identification Requirement: The primary renter must be at least 21 years old and present during the stay. Government-issued photo ID and agreement to house rules are required prior to check-in.

Quiet Hours & Community Guidelines: Wild Spur is located in a quiet residential neighborhood. Quiet hours are strictly enforced between 10:00 PM and 8:00 AM out of respect for our neighbors. Outdoor decibel monitors are active on the property to monitor noise levels (decibels only; no conversation is recorded).

Rooftop & Hot Tub Safety: Use of the 4th-floor rooftop deck, hot tub, and gas grill is at your own risk. Glassware is strictly prohibited on the rooftop deck—please use plastic or non-breakable drinkware.

Strict No Smoking / No Parties Policy: Smoking, vaping, or burning candles inside the home, on the balcony, or on the rooftop deck is strictly prohibited. Unapproved parties or gatherings will result in immediate reservation cancellation without refund.

Pet Policy: Please check with us prior to booking regarding our current pet policy, fees, and approval requirements.

VIP Access & Chauffeur Services: To take advantage of our partner network luxury airport transportation (Mercedes Sprinters, Escalades, etc.), requests must be coordinated at least 2 weeks prior to check-in.
